slides.say: A tooltip should sit above a button, or below it if there is no room. You need its height before the user sees it.
Use layout effect runs after React updates the DOM, but before the browser repaints. Measure the tooltip, and set state.
Here is the order of events.

events.label: Browser paints
events.note: user sees only the final spot

slides.text: The user never sees the wrong position.
slides.say: All of this happens before paint, so the user never sees the tooltip move.
